svg.aria-label: Output of the VYMEM synthetic demo
svg.text: $ npm run demo - Illustrative demo: real execution on a synthetic vault, not a production capture

g.text: VYMEM demo - synthetic vault, two fictional projects, two scripted MCP agents (real protocol, not real clients)
== 1. Initialise VYMEM against the synthetic vault (no private vault is involved)
PASS vymem init succeeded
PASS vymem doctor: MCP handshake passes
== 2. Agent A retrieves project context for orders-api
PASS project identified from the working directory -> matched_by=local_path
PASS purpose, blocker and related decision returned
PASS repository freshness checked (in sync at recorded commit) -> in_sync_or_not_comparable
PASS no handoffs exist yet
== 3. Agent A makes a controlled change in the orders-api repository
PASS change committed in the fictional repository -> HEAD 35ec125
== 4. Agent A records an UNAPPROVED evidence-backed handoff
PASS handoff stored in the AI Inbox -> Inbox/AI Inbox/handoffs/handoff-orders-api-jitter.md
PASS handoff is NOT approved
== 5. Agent B (separate gateway process) retrieves the previous handoff
PASS Agent B sees Agent A's handoff -> Inbox/AI Inbox/handoffs/handoff-orders-api-jitter.md
PASS it is flagged unapproved / unverified
PASS repository freshness now reports the vault note as behind HEAD -> repo_head_differs_from_note
== 6. Knowledge search returns relevant records
PASS memory note and handoff are found -> Agent Memory/Retry wrappers need jitter.md | Inbox/AI Inbox/handoffs/handoff-orders-api-jitter.md | Projects/orders-api.md
PASS handoff result is marked unverified
== 7. Duplicate updates are prevented
PASS identical resubmission is a no-op
PASS file is byte-identical and no extra files exist
PASS another agent cannot overwrite it (conflict) -> CONFLICT_DETECTED
PASS credential-like text is rejected -> REJECTED_SECRET_DETECTED
== 8. Approved and locked canonical records stay protected
PASS human_locked project note cannot even receive a proposal -> HUMAN_LOCKED
PASS proposal staged; canonical note untouched
PASS no MCP tool can apply a proposal or approve a record -> 7 tools
PASS owner approves the handoff via the local CLI -> APPROVED
PASS approved record is now protected from agents -> HUMAN_LOCKED
PASS owner applies the proposal via the local CLI (with backup)
PASS canonical note now contains the approved section
DEMO RESULT: 25/25 checks passed
